name: Booki
description: Booki — Agent-first Financial UI-SDK on Vercel UI SDK.

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @booki/core build && pnpm --filter @booki/primitives build && pnpm --filter @booki/react build && pnpm --filter @booki/styles build && pnpm build:frameworks && pnpm --filter @booki/readiness build
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/ensure-built.mjs && pnpm --filter @booki/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @booki/primitives typecheck && pnpm --filter @booki/react typecheck && pnpm --filter @booki/www typecheck && pnpm --filter @booki/web --filter @booki/vue --filter @booki/svelte --filter @booki/solid typecheck && pnpm --filter @booki/readiness typecheck && pnpm --filter @booki/example-ap-flow typecheck
scripts.coverage: node scripts/ensure-built.mjs && pnpm --filter @booki/core test:coverage && pnpm --filter @booki/primitives test:coverage && pnpm --filter @booki/react test:coverage
scripts.test: node scripts/ensure-built.mjs && pnpm --filter @booki/core test && pnpm --filter @booki/primitives test && pnpm --filter @booki/react test && pnpm --filter @booki/web test && pnpm --filter @booki/readiness test && pnpm --filter @booki/example-ap-flow test
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && pnpm generate:frameworks && pnpm format
